Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Playa del Carmen hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 15 of the 15 Playa del Carmen hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 8, Evendo at 2, eDreams at 1, HomeToGo at 1, pricetravel.com at 1, the hotel's own site at 1 and Vio.com at 1. Taxes and fees at Playa del Carmen hotels

At the 8 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 23% ($29 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 19% at Hyatt Centric Playa del Carmen to 27% at HOTEL BOUTIQUE CACHE. At 2 hotels the before-tax going rate was the same as the all-in one: the sites reported no taxes or fees on top. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
